Maria P (Partnerships): Hey team — kicking off the marketplace listing for Redwood Core Dedicated. Need alignment on legal artifacts, product bundle names, and AMI/container packaging. Can we do a quick preflight here?
Alex L (Legal): I can take the EULA + trial terms. Do we have a draft of the trial duration and data handling section?
Devin K (Product): Proposal: 14-day trial, no metered usage until opt-in. Bundle name suggestion: `redwood-core-dedicated-trial`. Thoughts?
Sam T (Cloud Ops): For AWS we'll need a validated AMI with startup script and cloud-init. Also an asset manifest with checksums. I'll put together an example.
Rachel C (Marketplace): Azure wants a separate VM image SKU and a short description (<=300 chars). Also need a support contact and entitlement mapping for reseller flows.
Alex L (Legal): 14 days OK. Send me the exact wording for the trial opt-in and any telemetry we collect. We need to add a line about telemetry anonymization and retention.
Maria P (Partnerships): Linking the working doc: https://redwood.work/docs/marketplace/redwood-core-listing (cc @Alex L @Sam T). Also attaching the proposed package manifest snippet below.
Maria P (Partnerships): ```
package_name: redwood-core-dedicated-trial
version: 2026-03-20
bundles:
  - name: runtime
    assets: [ami-12345, container:ghcr.io/redwood/core:dedicated-2026]
  - name: docs
    assets: [s3://redwood-assets/marketplace/docs.zip]
```
Devin K (Product): That manifest looks good. For marketing blurb: "Redwood Dedicated: predictable GPU inference with per-route SLAs and private deployment options." I'll trim to 300 chars for Azure.
Sam T (Cloud Ops): FYI for AMI build pipeline: `build-ami --region us-west-2 --preinstall redwood-runtime 1.2.0`. Need to confirm license acceptance flow on first boot.
Alex L (Legal): Boot-time license acceptance is fine, but we need the text that users see. Draft below: "By launching this AMI you accept the Redwood Inference Terms and the Trial Agreement (link)." I'll paste into the doc.
Rachel C (Marketplace): Can someone confirm the support email + escalation matrix? Marketplace will show primary contact on the listing.
Maria P (Partnerships): Support contact: support@redwood.ai, escalation: enterprise-support@redwood.ai. I'll add contacts to the doc and the publisher portal.
listings-bot: preflight check: asset-manifest checksum mismatch for `s3://redwood-assets/marketplace/docs.zip` expected `sha256:abc123` found `sha256:abf129`.
Sam T (Cloud Ops): On it — reuploading fixed artifact now.
Devin K (Product): QA note: we should include a short prompt-set example in the listing to demonstrate latency/cost numbers. Small code sample + sample outputs.
Alex L (Legal): Also confirm that trial data is deleted after 30 days if unused — need a retention clause.
Maria P (Partnerships): Action items: Alex to finalize EULA lines (due EOD Wed), Sam to publish AMI and update manifest (ETA tomorrow), Devin to shorten marketing blurb + prompt example (ETA EOD Tue), Rachel to create publisher-portal asset entries (ETA Thu). I'll follow up with a short checklist in the doc. :checkered_flag:
Rachel C (Marketplace): Sounds good. Ping me once assets are live and I'll kick off the cloud vendor validation.
Maria P (Partnerships): Thanks all — closing thread, will post updates in the working doc and tag this thread if anything fails during validation. :thumbsup:
